hero.badge: Dukkan ayyuka · App ɗaya · Damar da ba ta ƙarewa
headlines: Ma'auni ɗaya don duk abin da kake buƙata.
Biya kuɗaɗe, tura kuɗi, kuma yi ciniki da katunan kyauta.
Yi rijistar jiragen sama, otal da motoci a duniya baki ɗaya.
Nemi masana sana'a tabbatattu don aikinka na gaba.
hero.subtitle: Kiredit, data, DStv, wutar lantarki — haka kuma kasuwa, masana sana'a kusa da kai, katunan kyauta, tura kuɗi da tafiye-tafiye. Duk daga walat ɗaya.
hero.download: Sauke app na OAM a Google Play da App Store — ka riƙe duniya a hannunka.
